fusions.name: Pounce From Nowhere
fusions.desc: Springs at an enemy up to 7 tiles away and lands on it with every arm for 10 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 25% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Play Is Over
fusions.desc: Hooks an enemy from up to 4 tiles away for 16 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Through the Keyhole
fusions.desc: Teleports you to a spot up to 6 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Lands on Its Arms
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
